source.usage: aliases are ADDITIONAL query variants, never replacements for the printed form: substituting gains 24 places and loses 15 (n=88), because the postal form retrieves different documents rather than the same ones better. See process/atlas1908_reach.py.
source.false_positives: the within-province null verifies 1.8% of checkable name matches, so ~3 of the verified rows are expected to be chance. WHICH three is not identifiable per-row; the estimate is aggregate. Tighten with `km` if that matters - 12 of the 90 are within 5 km and 30 within 10 km.
